entities.name: Narciso Ventalló

entities.summary: Narcís Ventalló was a Catalan field hockey player. Throughout his career, he competed for Spain in the 1960 Summer Olympics, the 1964 Summer Olympics, and the 1968 Summer Olympics. He was born in Terrassa, Barcelona.
